label: TP
reason: XSS vulnerability confirmed: user-controlled cookie values (from request.getCookies()) are concatenated directly into HTML response without escaping (lines 106-111). Insecure randomness confirmed: java.util.Random.nextInt() produces cryptographically weak tokens used for authentication (line 97)

evidence.note: XSS sink - user cookie values concatenated to HTML output without escaping
Insecure randomness - java.util.Random.nextInt() used for authentication token
